description: This file defines the main React component for the EnhancedDashboardPage, including various child components for displaying dashboard metrics, charts, panels, and incident details. It fetches data via custom hooks, manages state, and constructs a complex, interactive dashboard UI for monitoring distributed agent networks.

classes.name: OverviewStripProps
classes.description: Props for the OverviewStrip component, containing dashboard overview and trend data.

classes.name: IncidentPanelProps
classes.description: Props for the IncidentPanel component, including incidents array.

classes.name: ReasonerSummary
classes.description: Represents summary info for a reasoner including its activity and agents.

classes.name: ReasonerAccumulator
classes.description: Helper structure for accumulating reasoner statistics during data processing.

classes.name: ReasonerActivityPanelProps
classes.description: Props for ReasonerActivityPanel component, including reasoners list and agent summary.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with fixed decimal digits, or returns '—' for undefined or invalid inputs.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Converts a duration in milliseconds to a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats an ISO string into locale string; returns '—' if input is invalid.
